ops.text: ccx vcs ship's atomic push to native GitHub stack branches was rejected twice on yasyf/cc-skills (Nov 5, 3:30 PM) with 'remote rejected ... fatal error in commit_refs_rules' for finder-body-edit-recheck and explain-quoted-lines, even a plain fast-forward git push of one branch, while a new non-stack branch pushed fine and 'gh stack push --no-atomic' pushed all four at once. It came right after 'gh stack merge 3421' rebased the rest of the stack server-side. ship should fall back to gh stack push (or a non-atomic push) for native stack members when GitHub returns that error, instead of saying 're-run this same command'.
